patches: Replace OpenClaw config/account imports with a transport-only metadata shim.
Replace the OpenClaw logger with stderr-only aggressive redaction; stdout remains NDJSON-only.
Wire the existing external AbortSignal contract into the vendored QR-status GET wrapper so binding cancellation interrupts long-poll immediately.
Adapt official QR status, getUpdates, sendMessage, typing and notify APIs behind the ZhiCe sidecar driver contract.
Commit get_updates_buf only after accepted/duplicate/rejected ACKs and persist opaque context-token references per account.

observations: Transient getUpdates TCP connect timeouts recovered and a later poll delivered the message.
The upstream OpenClaw logger prints full platform account identifiers; the ZhiCe vendored logger removes them.
The package README documents phone authorization but does not link separate online-service terms.
